seen.extent: 391 c. 287r: two lines of figures (about 90 digits) inside the clear letter of 26 Dec 1548. 392 c. 49r ('Inserto'): about 25 lines of figures with '+' marks (about 1,100 digits); its last line shows below the shorter leaves cc. 47 and 48. 393 c. 263r: a small slip with 7 lines of the same '+' figures.
seen.cipher: Figure cipher with '+' marks. 392: c. 47r-v is the bishop's own autograph letter (docket 'Dal vescovo di Pavia adi 7 di Marzo 48', signed 'Humil. ser.re il vescovo di Pavia', and it refers the duke to 'quello che li scrivo nel(l')incluso'); c. 48r, a separate smaller leaf laid over the insert, holds 19 lines of clear text in a neat chancery italic, not the bishop's hand, with no salutation, date or signature, ending in a flourish: 'oltre l'indicij che le scrissi per m. Severo, in quello discorso della guerra ne ritrovo alcuni altri ... Don Ferrante ... Granvela ... reformare Genoua et hauere il Piemonte ... degno della sua notitia'. That is the decipherment-slip form of this chancery, so c. 49 is glossed by c. 48. 393: c. 262r, filed in front of the cipher slip c. 263, carries 5 lines in the same chancery italic, no salutation or signature: 'se S. Ecc.za si sconciassi in accommodare ... potra fare come ha fatto il Duca di Ferrara, et li Lucchesi ... come dice il Car.le di Ravenna', the decipherment of c. 263. 391 c. 287r: the figures are written between two heavily struck-through lines of clear text (illegible at 2000 px); no decipherment on the neighbouring carte 284-290.
